name: GAKUEN-Tengoku
source:
The protagonist is suddenly chosen by God with the mission to “save the world.”
But to gather companions, he has to... kiss them!?
And both he and his potential allies are just regular guys who like girls—
what the heck is he supposed to do...!?
translation:
主角突然被上帝选中，肩负“拯救世界”的使命。
但为了聚集同伴，他必须……亲吻他们！？
而他和他的潜在盟友都只是喜欢女孩的普通男人——
他到底要做什么……！？
